faq.q: How can I place my item on a pure white field?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo, choose a pure white background and download the finished image for your listing.

faq.q: What is the easiest way to make a white marketplace image?
faq.a: Use a white background tool when you need the item isolated on an even field without booking a studio or masking it by hand.

faq.q: Do sales channels expect a plain white main shot?
faq.a: Some marketplaces ask for a pure white main image. Check the current rule for your category before you publish.

faq.q: Can a plain white field keep product depth?
faq.a: Even light and a soft contact shadow keep the item readable while the background stays plain.

faq.q: Can I post this image on Amazon or Shopify?
faq.a: Yes. Check each channel's current rule, then add the downloaded image to your listing or product media.

faq.q: How many credits does one photo use?
faq.a: You see the cost before you start. One photo uses 24 credits, and failed jobs return the credits.

faq.q: Can one white treatment cover my catalog?
faq.a: Yes. Apply one treatment across product photos so shoppers see a consistent first image.
